title: C# Math
description: The C# Math class has many methods that allow you to perform mathematical tasks on numbers.

challenges.title: Max Value
challenges.exercise: Print the highest value of 5 and 10 using Math.Max().

challenges.title: Min Value
challenges.exercise: Print the lowest value of 5 and 10 using Math.Min().

challenges.title: Square Root
challenges.exercise: Print the square root of 64 using Math.Sqrt().

challenges.title: Absolute Value
challenges.exercise: Print the absolute value of -4.7 using Math.Abs().

challenges.title: Rounding
challenges.exercise: Round 9.99 to the nearest integer using Math.Round().
